D5/S3/Quantum/Information/ActualPureQubi.name: D5.S3.Quantum.Information.ActualPureQubitCostInfimum.blochMatrix_trace
D5/S3/Quantum/Information/ActualPureQubi.signature: theorem blochMatrix_trace (a : ℝ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) : Matrix.trace (blochMatrix a r) = (a : ℂ)

D5/S3/Quantum/Information/ActualPureQubi.name: D5.S3.Quantum.Information.ActualPureQubitCostInfimum.bloch_blochMatrix
D5/S3/Quantum/Information/ActualPureQubi.signature: theorem bloch_blochMatrix (a : ℝ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) : bloch (blochMatrix a r) = r

D5/S3/Quantum/Information/ActualPureQubi.name: D5.S3.Quantum.Information.ActualPureQubitCostInfimum.bloch_geometry_of_isHermitian
D5/S3/Quantum/Information/ActualPureQubi.signature: theorem bloch_geometry_of_isHermitian (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (hM : M.IsHermitian) : M = blochMatrix (Matrix.trace M).re (bloch M) ∧ (Matrix.trace M = 1 → M * M = M → ‖bloch M‖ = 1)

D5/S3/Quantum/Information/ActualPureQubi.name: D5.S3.Quantum.Information.ActualPureQubitCostInfimum.norm_bloch_le_trace_of_posSemidef
D5/S3/Quantum/Information/ActualPureQubi.signature: theorem norm_bloch_le_trace_of_posSemidef (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (hM : M.PosSemidef) : ‖bloch M‖ ≤ (Matrix.trace M).re
